lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn6Cd2 (reduced formula Zn3Cd) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Cd and Zn centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors: Cd is surrounded by 12 Zn neighbors, while Zn has 4 Cd and 8 Zn neighbors, with neighbor distances ranging from 2.9155 to 2.9473 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Zn–Zn 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, while Cd–Zn polyhedra share corners and edges.
